description: This file declares API functions related to WAN manager configurations and operations, including parameter get/set functions, validation, commit, and rollback functions, as well as functions for group management when unification is enabled.

methods.name: WanManager_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: WanManager_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: WanManager_Validate
methods.description: Validates the current parameters before committing changes.

methods.name: WanManager_Commit
methods.description: Commits the current configuration changes.

methods.name: WanManager_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value.

methods.name: WanManager_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value.

methods.name: WanManager_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value.

methods.name: WanManager_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value.

methods.name: WanMgr_DnsConnectivityCheck_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves DNS connectivity check parameter boolean value.

methods.name: WanMgr_DnsConnectivityCheck_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets DNS connectivity check parameter boolean value.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the WAN manager group has been updated.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes WAN manager group data.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the WAN manager group.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entry from the WAN manager group.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets a ULONG parameter value for a group entry.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value for a group entry.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets a bool parameter value for a group entry.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a bool parameter value for a group entry.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_Validate
methods.description: Validates the group entry parameters before applying.

methods.name: WanManagerGroup_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to a group entry.
